title: Skip provisioning admission hooks on a subresource write only when spec/secure provably unchanged
answers: Status patch fails with an unrelated spec validation/mutation error
PATCH /status on Repository or Connection blocked by mutation hook error
Why does updating status re-run spec validation
How to skip mutation/validation for a provisioning subresource request
body:
Symptom: provisioning status-only PATCH requests (e.g. PATCH .../status) failed with mutation/validation errors about spec (e.g. "resolve gitlab project: authentication failed", "spec.github.path: duplicate repository path") even though the request only touched status, so status could never be updated to reflect the real failure.
Root cause: Mutate/Validate on Repository and Connection ran unconditionally on every update including subresource requests, re-mutating/re-validating spec/secure that wasn't part of the request.
Fix pattern: at the top of Mutate/Validate, when a.GetSubresource() != "", call provisioningadmission.SpecAndSecureChanged(a); if false, return nil immediately without running spec/secure mutation or validation.
Constraints: only skip when GetSubresource() is non-empty AND SpecAndSecureChanged is false; a subresource request that bundles a real spec/secure change must still go through the normal hooks, so new subresource handlers must perform both checks together (not "subresource != spec" alone) or invalid spec changes get smuggled through disguised as status writes.
applies: apps/provisioning admission Mutate/Validate hooks for Repository and Connection, and any future provisioning kind that handles subresource updates
says: Status-only patch blocked by mutation error about unchanged spec field.
Updating repository status fails with spec validation error.
PATCH /status rejected because spec re-validation runs inappropriately.
Status update re-validates specification even though spec didn't change.
How to skip spec validation when patching status subresource only?
search: Skip provisioning admission spec/secure mutation and validation only when both conditions hold: GetSubresource() is non-empty AND provisioningadmission.SpecAndSecureChanged(a) returns false; call SpecAndSecureChanged at top of Mutate/Validate in apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/mutator.go, apps/provisioning/pkg/connection/mutator.go and their validators. Cannot skip with subresource-check alone; a subresource request that bundles real spec/secure changes must pass both checks or invalid spec changes get smuggled through. Applies to provisioning admission hooks for Repository and Connection (apps/provisioning/pkg/repository and pkg/connection) and any future provisioning kind handling subresource updates.
